offer_spectrum.name: Offer Spectrum
offer_spectrum.when: When evaluating or designing any offer

front_end_back_end.name: Front-End vs Back-End Offers
front_end_back_end.when: When designing a revenue system with multiple offers
front_end_back_end.principle: Front-end attracts and converts. Back-end generates real profit.
front_end_back_end.note: Front-end can even lose money if back-end profit justifies it

wave_fee_offer.name: Wave Fee Offer
wave_fee_offer.when: When pricing high-ticket services or memberships
wave_fee_offer.formula: 'I'll waive the $30K fee if you commit for the year. If you cancel early, you pay the difference.'
wave_fee_offer.psychology: Commitment = lower risk for you. The fee feels waived, not eliminated.

surge_pricing.name: Surge Pricing (SMART)
surge_pricing.when: When optimizing pricing for demand management
surge_pricing.tactic: Higher prices during peak demand. Frame as 'weekdays get discount' not 'weekends cost more'.
surge_pricing.benefit: Smooths demand curve, better staff utilization

content_scaling_machine.name: Content is a Machine
content_scaling_machine.principle: Content is a machine, not art. Build systems that produce winners consistently, not one-off viral hits.
quick_wins: Ask 10 followers to post their results (incentivize)
Take your best-performing post, create 5 variations
Hire a Gen Z person to handle short-form content
Create a content calendar for next 30 days
Start repurposing one piece of content into 10 formats

key_tactics: No offer → Bad Offer → Decent Offer → Good Offer → Grand Slam Offer. Most people stop at Decent.
Front-end attracts, back-end profits. Design both intentionally.
The Wave Fee Offer shifts risk from you to commitment — powerful psychological frame
Surge pricing smooths demand: frame discounts for off-peak, not penalties for peak
Content is a machine — optimize for gross profit x units sold, not views or likes
Testing: start with 5-6% increase on highest volume items, monitor conversion, iterate
